title: Manage Ploinky Agents
summary: Defines how to create, update, review, and secure Ploinky agents while preserving agent identity, the router-mediated boundary (with a declared media/data-plane exception), the JWT families, and fail-closed MCP policy, and resynchronizing the owning repository's specifications with gamp-specs after every change.
outputs: validated manifest.json in the target Ploinky repository
validated mcp-config.json in the target Ploinky repository
resynchronized docs/specs/ and HTML documentation in the owning repository
